heroes.description: Fires a powerful bullet at a single target, dealing physical normal damage equal to (130/150/170/200 + SP*0.02)% of ATK.
Unleash a piercing aura dealing damage to all enemies in a straight line within 1/3/5/7 horizontal blocks.
Generates Protection upon herself with her willpower.
Deals damage and freezes enemies within range.
Transforms into werewolf with 280% HP and 150% ATK. Charges at farthest enemy.
Strikes the Holy Blade down, then attacks with it for 5/6/7/8 sec with increased ATK.
Smites enemies with shield, dealing damage and stunning enemies.
Ambushes the target from their back, dealing SP damage.
Grants Protection and converts ATK/Spell Power to linked target's base stats. TOP TIER support.
Deals damage to farthest enemy and reduces its AtkSpd.
Links 3 targets with chains, making them share damage, stun and slow effects.
Throws bombs to random enemies with extra speed.
Deals damage to enemy with lowest HP ratio. Damage increases per target's lost HP.
Deals damage in front. After 3 casts, Azure Dragon Slash deals 2.5x damage in wide range.
Launch wave hitting enemy and ally back and forth, dealing damage and healing.
Increases Attack Speed by (50 + SP)% for 3/5/7/9 sec.
Attacks 3/4/5/6 more times for 6 sec.
Summons Sha-Sha golem with 150% HP/ATK. Heals HP.
For 4 sec, increases DEF, becomes immune to CC, gains 100% Spell HP Drain.
Breathes flame dealing damage to enemies in front 15 times.
Forms magical garden that damages enemies and heals allies.
Smashes hammer dealing damage to all enemies in blocks nearby.
Deal damage multiple times in front. Attack count increases (Max 6 times).
Lands in front of ally, dealing damage and pushing enemies back.
Leaps to strike dealing SP + % of target's Max HP damage.
Discharges lightning that bounces between enemies.
Recovers MP of all nearby allies. TOP TIER support.
Recovers HP of himself and all nearby allies.
Drops meteors dealing damage to enemies within range multiple times.
